note: ⛔ SNG-462. Two Mind social abilities closing the `provoke` and `soothe` zeros. See SYSTEM_SPEC §31.5.

abilities.name: Cold Certainty
abilities.narrationHints: They say something quiet and specific about the person, and the person stops arguing and starts deciding — badly, and fast, and in public.
abilities.description: Name the thing a person is most afraid is true about them, and let them act on it — you do not tell them what to do, you make waiting unbearable.
abilities.notFor: Anyone who genuinely does not care what you think; crowds; making someone do a SPECIFIC thing — you get action, not obedience.

bounds.text: ⛔ YOU GET ACTION, NOT OBEDIENCE — they move, and what they do is theirs
it must be TRUE, or true enough that they fear it is
⚠️ they remember who said it, and people do not forgive this
one person, in earshot, who cares what is said about them

abilities.plainly: A social/duel action that provokes a target into acting. It rolls 2d6. Range is 6. Ranks: rank 2 provokes a group, rank 3 forces a public commitment.

tree.name: Named Aloud
tree.grants: ⛔ NAME IT AND THEY MOVE. The careful one attacks; the patient one speaks out of turn; the liar over-explains. You have taken away their option to wait.
tree.cannot: One person, in earshot, who cares what is said of them. What they do next is their choice, not yours.

tree.name: The Room Hears It
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS TARGETS AND WITNESSES. Say it where it lands on several at once — a command group, a council, a family — and each of them moves on their own account.
tree.cannot: The more people hear it, the less precisely it lands on any one of them.

tree.name: On the Record
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS PERMANENCE. Provoke a commitment they cannot walk back — an oath, an accusation, an order given in front of the people who must carry it out. ⚠️ They will regret it and they will honour it.
tree.cannot: They must have standing to lose. Someone with no reputation cannot be trapped by one.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-462. `provoke` was ZERO across all 342 abilities. ⚠️ THE ONLY SOCIAL VERB WHOSE SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE THE TARGET'S OWN CHOICE — which is why it belongs to the mind tradition and why it is a weapon rather than a conversation.

abilities.name: Quiet the Room
abilities.narrationHints: Nobody is told to calm down. The shouting simply runs out of somewhere to go, and afterwards people cannot say who stopped it.
abilities.description: Take the heat out of a person or a room — panic, grief, rage, the moment before a fight — so that whatever happens next is chosen rather than spilled.
abilities.notFor: Making anyone agree with you; a fear that is correct; anything already in motion — a swung blade lands.

bounds.text: ⛔ IT REMOVES HEAT, NOT REASONS. They still want what they wanted, calmly
nothing already in motion stops — a swung blade lands
⚠️ it works on YOU too, and a person who needed their fear may resent that
a second use on the same people the same day does much less

abilities.plainly: A social/survive action that soothes fear, grief or rage. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10. Ranks: rank 2 covers a crowd, rank 3 restores someone already broken.

tree.name: Take the Heat Out
tree.grants: ⛔ ONE PERSON OR A SMALL GROUP STOPS BEING RUN BY IT — the panicking stop panicking, the grieving can speak, the man about to swing lowers his arm and thinks about it.
tree.cannot: They still want what they wanted. It removes heat, not reasons.

tree.name: The Whole Room
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS SCALE. A crowd, a rout, a market turning ugly, a ward full of wounded — the temperature comes down across all of it at once.
tree.cannot: The larger the room, the shallower it goes. A determined agitator can bring it back up.

tree.name: Back From It
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS RECOVERY. Bring one person back from where fear or grief has already taken them — the broken soldier, the witness who has stopped speaking, the one who has decided to die.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ One person, and it takes a quiet hour. It gives them back the ability to choose; it does not choose for them.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-462. `soothe` was ZERO corpus-wide. ⚠️ Distinct from `heal`, which mends a body — this takes the heat out of a mind, and the r3 recovery case is what the game had no ability for at all.
